name: Issue 733: Blightbreaker halves Mercy's tick interval and doubles its cost
contract: #733: Blightbreaker 707433 reads 'Increases the tick rate of Mercy by $s1%, but increases its mana cost by $s2%.' Effect 0 is aura 108 SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME (19) at -50 and effect 1 is aura 108 SPELLMOD_COST (14) at +100, both on EffectSpellClassMask [32, 0, 0] in family 33, which is Mercy 504848's SpellFamilyFlags word 0. Mercy's effect 0 is aura 23 with a 3000 ms amplitude, so a fresh Mercy should tick every 1500 ms (the repo's tick-rate convention, as for Fearmonger and Explosive) and cost twice as much. A previous live run found the applied Mercy still at 3000 ms. Each link is asserted separately so the first failing step names the broken one: the passive's aura, the modifier query without a cast, the cost, then the amplitude of a real self-cast. Only the Blightbreaker caster casts Mercy, and every aura read names its caster: Mercy chains to nearby allies (sun-cleric-mercy), so a second caster's Mercy on the same player would otherwise be read instead.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Blightbreaker's passive aura is on the caster
Control's Mercy tick modifier is untouched
Blightbreaker halves Mercy's tick interval in the modifier query
Blightbreaker caster's Mercy ticks every 1500 ms
